title: Demosaic Interpolator
text: Construct RGB pixel data from Bayer pattern pixel stream, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Sensor alignment} sets Color sequence of the pixels in the input stream; {Interpolation algorithm} sets the algorithm used to calculate missing pixel values Gradient-corrected and {Line buffer size} sets the size of line memory buffer. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

params.name: Interpolation algorithm
params.values: Algorithm used to calculate missing pixel values Gradient-corrected linear (default) | Bilinear

params.name: Sensor alignment
params.values: Color sequence of the pixels in the input stream RGGB (default) | GBRG | GRBG | BGGR

params.name: Line buffer size
params.values: Size of line memory buffer 2048 (default) | integer
